fit_boundary: Every fitted statistic is computed from training split examples only, after split assignment and before validation evaluation. Validation and test use the frozen training-derived transform.
fitted_artifact_policy: No fitted preprocessing artifact, statistics file, or transformed dataset is created by this planning task; no fitted statistic is calculated here.

rf.reason: The accepted RF predictors are numeric design/configuration fields and the selected estimators are tree-based; no scaling is required or permitted.

future_fitted_artifact.top_level_field_order_is_not_semantic: Canonical serialization sorts object keys lexicographically; arrays retain the defined semantic order.
future_fitted_artifact.path_policy: The future artifact contains no machine-specific absolute paths; dataset identity is represented by accepted manifest SHA-256 values only.

field_definitions.dataset_manifest_identities: The accepted RF and TGNN dataset manifest SHA-256 identities used by the fit; no machine-specific absolute paths.
field_definitions.training_index_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes of the frozen training index consumed by fitting.
field_definitions.accepted_node_feature_order: The exact 14-feature order frozen in tgnn_node_features.exact_order.
field_definitions.scaled_feature_order: The exact six-feature order frozen in tgnn_node_features.scaled_features.
field_definitions.applicability_masks: Named node-type masks that determine which values are fitted and transformed for each scaled feature.
field_definitions.per_feature_statistics: An array in scaled_feature_order; each record has exactly the required per-feature fields.
field_definitions.zero_variance_policy: The frozen behavior for population standard deviation equal to zero.
field_definitions.fit_sample_count: The number of training samples/realization sequences included in the fit, recorded as an integer.
field_definitions.fit_design_count: The number of distinct training design_id values included in the fit, recorded as an integer.

applicability_masks.mask_source: Node type and these frozen masks determine applicability; value == 0 never determines applicability.

field_definitions.applicability_node_type: The node type accepted by the corresponding applicability mask; ground_station.
field_definitions.applicable_value_count: Count of applicable training values used for that feature's statistics.
field_definitions.mean_float64_hex: Python float.hex() string after conversion to IEEE-754 float64.
field_definitions.population_std_float64_hex: Python float.hex() string for the population standard deviation after conversion to IEEE-754 float64.
field_definitions.zero_variance: Boolean true exactly when the population standard deviation is zero.

future_fitted_artifact.fit_sample_count: Integer populated by the future fit; no value is calculated in this planning task.
future_fitted_artifact.fit_design_count: Integer populated by the future fit; no value is calculated in this planning task.

zero_variance_policy.division_by_zero: never divide by zero; use transformed value 0.0 for applicable values when population standard deviation is zero

serialization.array_order: Defined semantic array order is retained; sort_keys applies only to JSON object keys.
serialization.canonical_bytes: Encode the exact JSON text using UTF-8 after applying these settings, with no byte-order mark and no final newline.

hashing.input: The exact canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes of the statistics artifact.

statistic_convention: One global training-derived mean and population standard deviation per scaled feature across training designs, realizations, snapshots, and applicable nodes; no validation or test value contributes to fitting.

applicability_masks.ground_only_features: latitude_deg, longitude_deg, altitude_m, ecef_x_km, ecef_y_km, ecef_z_km are fitted only on ground-station nodes
applicability_masks.satellite_only_indices: plane_index and satellite_within_plane_index remain unscaled and are zero on ground-station nodes
applicability_masks.one_hot_and_status: node-type, station-class, and operational_indicator fields remain binary and unscaled

sentinel_zero_policy: Canonical positive zero for a non-applicable field remains exactly zero after transformation; it is excluded from fitted statistics through the applicability mask. An applicable physical value equal to zero is included using its node-type applicability mask, so sentinel and physical zero are not conflated. Non-applicable values remain exactly 0.0 after transformation.
temporal_policy: Statistics are pooled over training snapshots only; no validation/test snapshot contributes to fitting, and no per-run or per-snapshot refit is allowed.

tgnn_edge_attributes.unscaled_features: all ten accepted attributes remain in canonical source units and binary one-hot form
tgnn_edge_attributes.reason: The contracted v1 GCLSTM consumes accepted edge_index connectivity and no edge_attr-derived scalar; scaling or reducing edge_attr would not be used by this architecture and would alter the accepted input contract.
tgnn_edge_attributes.sentinel_zero_policy: Positive zero remains the non-applicable value for attributes of the other edge type; edge-type applicability is represented by the accepted one-hot fields. No missing edge is represented by a fabricated edge or imputed attribute.
tgnn_edge_attributes.zero_edge_snapshots: edge_attr remains shape [0,10] with no statistics fitted from its empty population.

leakage_controls: No target, target derivative, whole-run summary, split label, identifier, or hash is a feature.
No statistic is fitted from validation or test data.
No target normalization or regression-target transformation is permitted in v1.
Any future change to scaling, sentinel handling, or target transformation requires a new frozen plan.
